description: We are team of multidisciplinary crew of innovators, coders, and problem-solvers united for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. For the Health Monitoring for Astronauts challenge, our mission is to safeguard human health beyond Earth. By combining real-time biometric tracking with intelligent data analysis, we are developing a seamless, non-invasive system to monitor astronaut well-being during long-duration space missions.

details:
ASTROVITAL is a passive, body-centric health-monitoring cockpit for astronauts on long-duration missions, built for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

On long flights the human body degrades system by system — bone density, muscle mass, vision (SANS from fluid shifts), cardiovascular and more — slowly and silently. Crews are too busy to watch dozens of numbers, and generic population thresholds miss what’s abnormal for one individual. ASTROVITAL closes that gap.

The approach is fully passive: every value arrives automatically from suit-integrated and spacecraft sensors — the astronaut never enters health data by hand. The dashboard works perfectly with zero manual input; they can optionally ask questions, log symptoms, or explore any body part.

The centerpiece is a real-time 3D human body (Three.js). Rotate, zoom, and click any region — down to individual organs — to see that part’s live status. The 3D model is the primary navigation, not decoration, and it’s mirrored by a keyboard-accessible region list that works even without WebGL.

What makes it trustworthy:

Personalized baselines — each indicator is scored against the astronaut’s own 30-day mean ± 1 SD, shown as a band on every chart, not population averages.

Three-tier alerts (Baseline → Caution → Warning) with anti-desensitization limits to prevent alert fatigue, so a warning still means something.

DoctorBot gives plain-language, step-by-step suggested actions — never a diagnosis; every warning has a Contact Flight Surgeon path, and the astronaut keeps final authority.

Hardware-aware — each data source is labeled, and indicators needing new hardware (microneedle patch, wearable ultrasound, neck-ring impedance) carry a NEW badge.

Section 508 accessible — text alongside every color, full keyboard navigation, glove-friendly 48px touch targets, ARIA roles.

Tech: Three.js (WebGL) + a minimal Express server, vanilla ES-module front end, no database — all sensor data is simulated client-side with 30 days of history.

Live demo: https://dhakshesh7575-lang.github.io/ · Source: ASTROVITAL-Dhakshesh
